name: caps-lock-state
description: This is a Visual Studio Code plugin that provides panels to display the Caps Lock key's status.

caps-lock-state.delay_time.markdownDescription: Polling interval for detecting Caps Lock state changes (ms). Lower values = faster response, higher CPU usage.

enumDescriptions: Cursor Color: Change the editor cursor color when Caps Lock is ON. Configure with `editorCursor.foreground` below.
Background Color: Highlight the current line with a background color when Caps Lock is ON. Configure with `background_color` below.
Status Bar: Show a text indicator in the status bar when Caps Lock is ON. Configure with `status_bar_text` below.
Gutter Icon: Show a lock icon in the editor gutter when Caps Lock is ON. No additional configuration needed.
caps-lock-state.display_method.markdownDescription: Choose how Caps Lock state is indicated in the editor.

caps-lock-state.editorCursor.foreground.markdownDescription: Only for `method_cursor_color`. The cursor color when Caps Lock is ON. Examples: `#00ff00`, `red`, `rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)`

caps-lock-state.status_bar_text.markdownDescription: Only for `method_status_bar`. The text shown in the status bar when Caps Lock is ON. Examples: `🔒 Caps Lock ON!`, `⚠ CAPS`, `[A]`

caps-lock-state.background_color.markdownDescription: Only for `method_background_color`. The background color of the current line when Caps Lock is ON. Examples: `rgba(255,0,0,0.7)`, `#ff0000b3`, `red`

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
